title: A Chance Arrangement
description: Brynjolf in Riften proposes a scheme to frame the vendor Brand-Shei by stealing Madesi's silver ring and planting it on him, offering gold and a chance to join the Thieves Guild in return.

base_facts: A member of the Thieves Guild operating in Riften's marketplace.
Sells a supposed Falmer Blood Elixir as a front for his schemes.
Can be found at the Riften bazaar during the day or at The Bee and Barb at night.

BRYNJOLF_SCHEME: Wants to frame Brand-Shei by planting a stolen ring on him to get him arrested.
Will create a distraction in the bazaar while the player steals the ring.
ACCEPT_STEAL_RING: The player agreed to steal Madesi's Silver Ring during my distraction.
The player should steal Madesi's Silver Ring from the strongbox under Madesi's stall.
SPEAK_TO_BRYNJOLF: Satisfied with the outcome of the scheme and pays 100 septims.
Offers the player a chance to join the Thieves Guild.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Considers this the beginning of a profitable friendship with the player.
Quest completes; Brynjolf rewards the player with 100 gold and offers Thieves Guild membership.
Speak to Brynjolf to receive a reward of 100 septims and a chance to join the Thieves Guild .

If you speak to Maul after speaking to Brynjolf and pick the conversational option "Know anything about the Thieves Guild?" , the miscellaneous quest "Talk to Brynjolf about joining the Thieves Guild" may become stuck.

base_facts: An Argonian jeweler with a stall in Riften's marketplace.
Keeps his silver ring in a locked strongbox inside the cabinet under his counter.
A Dunmer merchant selling wares in Riften's marketplace.
Someone wants him in jail where he cannot interfere with their activities.

PLANT_RING_ON_BRAND_SHEI: Has been framed for theft and will be arrested by the Riften guards.

beats.comment: Brynjolf approaches the player with his scheme to frame Brand-Shei.
Player explicitly agrees to help Brynjolf by stealing Madesi's Silver Ring.
beats.intent_summary: Player commits to stealing Madesi's Silver Ring for Brynjolf's scheme.

triggers.intent: Player explicitly agrees to steal Madesi's Silver Ring for Brynjolf.
examples_yes: Okay, I will steal the ring.
I'll get Madesi's ring for you.
I will take the ring and plant it.
Fine, I'll steal the ring during your distraction.
examples_no: Why do you want Brand-Shei framed?
I don't want to steal anything.

beats.comment: Player must steal Madesi's Silver Ring from his strongbox during Brynjolf's distraction.
Player plants Madesi's stolen ring on Brand-Shei via reverse pickpocket, or drops the ring and reports failure.
Player reports back to Brynjolf after the scheme, whether the pickpocket succeeded, failed, or the player took too long.
Quest completes; Brynjolf rewards the player with 100 gold and offers Thieves Guild membership.
